claim_boundaries.constructed_center_only: The inherited centered coordinates use an algebraic origin reconstructed from edge vectors. They are not observed or labeled object, scene, camera or physical centers.
claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The inherited constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic reference, not recovered fixture truth, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.exactness_domain: Exact means equality over rational interpretations of pinned finite binary floating-point values. It does not authenticate source precision, physical truth, uncertainty or measurement accuracy.
claim_boundaries.no_tensor_invariance_or_spectral_claim: The component list is not interpreted as a tensor or physical inertia object. No coordinate, frame or translation invariance, spectral property, principal direction, eigenvalue, conditioning or ranking is claimed.
claim_boundaries.no_vector_cross_product: Cross-product identity names refer only to scalar products between fixed coordinate components. No 3D vector cross product, normal or orientation is computed or inferred.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_endpoint: Rows have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0,rhat,r and answer neither A7 nor any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.products_not_physical_or_statistical_qua: Coordinate products are retained solely to check the stated identity. They are not covariance, variance, a population moment, physical scatter, inertia, distance, area, image footprint or a metric-quality estimate.
claim_boundaries.science_annotation_and_release: No raw bytes, labels, manifest, annotation eligibility, inference, forecast metric, current-state claim, stage gate, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: The three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population, representation or camera effect is estimated.

construction_semantics.centered_coordinate_formulas: The inherited exact algebraic origin uses a_c=(eAB+eAC)/3, b_c=(-2*eAB+eAC)/3 and c_c=(eAB-2*eAC)/3.
construction_semantics.component_identity: For each fixed coordinate pair p,q, the audit verifies exactly that sum_i c_i[p]*c_i[q] equals one third of the sum over AB,AC,BC of edge[p]*edge[q]. Each term is an ordinary scalar product of two fixed coordinate components; no vector cross product is computed.
construction_semantics.excluded_operations: No square root, eigendecomposition, normalization, tolerance, threshold, classification, fitting, registration or ranking is performed.
construction_semantics.fixed_order: A=banana,B=bowl,C=rubiks_cube with eAB=A-B,eAC=A-C,eBC=B-C. World component order is xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz; projected order is xx,xy,yy. No source row, object, operand, coordinate or camera reordering occurs.
construction_semantics.stored_coordinate_domain: Each finite stored edge coordinate is interpreted as its exact binary floating-point rational value. Integer numerator/denominator strings control equality; approximate numbers are display aids only.
construction_semantics.units_and_scope: World component records use stored m^2 units and projected records use stored px^2 units. These are frozen residual-vector coordinate products, not physical or image-object measurements.

finding: All 54 world and 108 projected fixed components have zero exact identity residual. The package serializes 648 exact rational records and revalidates all 1,008 Turn2854 exact records. This is a deterministic stored-coordinate algebra check only, not physical, statistical or scientific evidence.
